description: This JavaScript source file defines the 'TransactionController' class within the 'erpnext' namespace. The class extends 'erpnext.taxes_and_totals' and manages client-side behaviors for transaction documents in ERPNext, including setup routines, item handling, tax calculations, currency conversions, barcode scanning, quality inspections, and form refresh/update logic. It is tailored specifically for handling transactions like Sales Invoice, Purchase Receipt, Delivery Note, and similar documents, providing functionality for item management, pricing rules, taxes, shipping, and related workflows.

classes.name: TransactionController
classes.description: Client-side controller for managing transactions, extending ERPNext's 'taxes_and_totals' for handling complex calculation, item, tax, currency, and workflow logic within transaction forms.
